name: Tokyo Chaan (Shibuya)
editor_note: Small English-led sessions a five-minute walk from Shibuya Station, with the host in kimono. An easy first ceremony; there's no kimono rental, so come as you are.
price_note: ¥3,900 shared / ¥7,800 private per adult, from the official plans page, read 2026-11-03.
notes: 2F Manji Building, 1-15-9 Dogenzaka. 45-60 minutes. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
